artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem
artworks.description: The image shows a crucifixion scene with three figures. The central figure is nailed to a cross. To the left stands a figure in robes with a halo. To the right, another figure with a halo and long hair stands holding a garment. The background includes rolling hills and a simple structure in the distance.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem
artworks.medium: engraving with traces of hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a depiction of Jesus Christ on the cross, with figures representing Mary and John the Apostle. Jesus is central, nailed to the cross with arms outstretched, with a somber expression. Mary is to the left in long robes, while John is on the right. Six angels surround Jesus, some holding instruments of the passion, and one kneeling near His feet. Skulls and bones are scattered below the cross. The background is intricate with swirling patterns and halos around Mary's and John's heads.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem
artworks.description: The image shows three figures. The central figure is Jesus Christ on the cross, with his arms outstretched and head tilted to one side. He wears a crown of thorns and a cloth around his waist. To the left is a woman with a sorrowful expression, wearing a veil and robes. To the right is a younger man with curly hair, gesturing with one hand. Both figures also have halos. The background is simple and neutral, drawing attention to the figures.

artworks.title: The Birth of the Virgin
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Hans Holbein the Elder
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with various figures engaged in domestic activities. The drawing showcases a room with a bed in the foreground, on which an infant is held by a seated figure. Several vessels are positioned near a wooden tub that rests on the ground. A figure stands adjacent to a table, appearing to pour liquid from a jug into another container. Beyond the figures, an architectural scene unfolds in the background with a couple engaging on a staircase that leads outside, hinting at an exterior with a fence and tree. The drawing is characterized by intricate line work and hatching that conveys texture and depth. This composition captures a moment of household activity, combining elements of care, domestic chores, and interaction.

artworks.title: The Marriage of the Virgin
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Hans Holbein the Elder
artworks.description: The image depicts an interior scene with a ceremonial event. The composition is split into two parts: the foreground shows figures in elaborate garments engaged in a ritual, while the background features a grand architectural setting with columns, a platform, an altar, candles, and figures in the distance. The scene conveys a formal and ceremonial atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Presentation in the Temple
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Hans Holbein the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows several figures in an interior setting. The central figure, a bearded man in ornate robes and a mitre, is holding a small, nude infant towards a woman in flowing robes. Surrounding them are other figures, both male and female, in period-appropriate clothing. The setting includes architectural elements like a tiled floor and a decorative pillar with a gothic arch pattern. In the background, more figures are engaged in various activities, with detailed surroundings including candle holders and a small gallery above. The image is rendered in a tonal, etched style.

artworks.title: Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Hans Holbein the Elder
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historic scene with many figures involved in a dramatic event with infants. The drawing shows a ruler or king seated on a throne, observing chaos and turmoil. Adult figures are standing and moving around, some holding infants. The lower part of the composition shows several infants in different positions. Women appear to be pleading or protecting other infants. In the background, there are horses and additional figures. The drawing is highly detailed with intricate linework typical of engravings or etchings. The atmosphere is tense, capturing a moment of historical or biblical significance.

artworks.title: The Death of the Virgin
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 24.8 x 16.9 cm (9 3/4 x 6 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an intricate black and white engraving depicting a group of people gathered around a person who appears to be lying in bed. The central figure is a woman sitting up in bed with a serene expression on her face. She has long, wavy hair and wears a headpiece. She wears flowing garments and holds a small object in her hand. Another person, possibly a man, wearing a cap and ornate clothing, supports her. Surrounding her are several men with varying expressions, who are dressed in long robes. Some have curly hair and beards, and one leans closely near the woman as if engaged in communication. A man at the bottom right is kneeling and reading from an open book while holding a long staff. The figures are surrounded by intricately detailed drapery and a curtain, suggesting a room of some formality or significance. The background of the image is composed of patterned and shaded walls. A large, candle-like object stands in front of the bed.

artworks.title: Christ Appearing to the Disciples
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem

artworks.title: Virgin and Child in a Courtyard
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Martin Schongauer
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman holding a child on her lap. The woman and child have halos around their heads. The woman's hair is long and wavy, and she wears a detailed robe. They are in front of a stone wall with a building in the background, and a tree with twisting branches to the right.

artworks.title: The Madonna with the Clock
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem
artworks.description: The image features several figures within a circular border. A seated woman wearing a crown and robes holds a child on her lap. To her right, a figure in robes with obscured facial features and on the left, an angelic figure with wings. Scrolls and embellishments surround the figures within the circular frame, set against an intricate background.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem
artworks.description: The image shows multiple individuals in an architectural setting. In the center foreground, there are two seated figures; one is a woman with long hair, wearing a robe, holding a child with a halo. Beside her, another woman in a robe with a headscarf gestures towards the child. Two men frame the scene. On the left, a man leans against a partition and on the right, a man wears a hat and has a beard. Above them, a man with a bishop's mitre floats among clouds with his hands raised, and a dove radiating light below. The background features gothic architectural elements such as arches and columns.

artworks.title: Saint Paul (?) or Saint Matthew (?)
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Master E.S.
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with a turned posture. They have long, wavy hair and a full beard, with defined facial features. The person is wearing a long robe with patterns along the edges, holding a book in one hand and a staff in the other. A circular halo is around their head. The background has a lined pattern with a textured surface. The name "Matheus" is inscribed above their shoulder in ornate script, and the floor is tiled in a three-dimensional pattern.

artworks.title: Saint Andrew
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Master E.S.
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with a slight tilt in his posture, holding an X-shaped object. He has long hair and a beard, a prominent nose, and appears slightly aged. He wears a long robe, with the fabric draping in folds, and he is barefoot on a tiled floor. A halo adorns his head, and he wears a bracelet on his wrist. The background is a plain, etched surface, with an inscription reading "Andreas" to the left.

artworks.title: Saint James the Great
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Master E.S.
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded man standing upright. He has long, wavy hair and a thick beard. He wears a robe, a cloak with ornate clasps, a wide-brimmed hat with a shell-like emblem, and holds a staff with a shell at the top in his right hand. In his left hand, he holds the hilt of a large sword resting against his left shoulder. A pouch hangs from his belt. He stands on a tiled floor, with a plain background and decorative text near the top of the image.

artworks.title: Saint James the Less
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Master E.S.
artworks.description: The image shows a person kneeling with a slight forward lean. The person has medium-length hair, closed eyes, and softly closed lips, wearing long, flowing robes with intricate detailing. They hold an object resembling a long scroll or musical instrument in one hand while the other hand cradles it. An aura or halo surrounds their head. The background is plain with a subtle horizontal line indicating a floor or ground level beneath. The image is rendered in a monochromatic tone resembling an engraving or etching.

artworks.title: Saint Philip
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Master E.S.
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body engraving of a standing figure in profile, facing right. The person is walking, indicated by their slightly forward-leaning posture. The figure has a prominent nose, a high forehead, and a shaved head with short hair. They wear a long robe and hold a book in their left hand and a staff with a cross in their right hand. The background is plain with a tiled surface pattern on the floor.

artworks.title: Saint Bartholomew
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Master E.S.
artworks.description: The image depicts a standing man holding a large knife in one hand and a book in the other. He has curly hair, a thick beard, and a serious expression. He is wearing a long robe with a cloak draped over his shoulders, adorned with patterns. His footwear also has patterns. The background shows a plain wall with the name "Sanct Bartholomeus" written above, and a tiled floor.

artworks.title: Saint Thomas (?) or Saint Simon (?)
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Master E.S.
artworks.description: The illustration depicts a person standing with one foot forward, holding a staff against their shoulder. The person has distinct facial features, including a beard and medium-length hair. They wear a robe with a buttoned section near the neck. A halo encircles their head. The text "Simeon" is to the right. The background is a textured surface with a faint frame.

artworks.title: Saint Simon Zelotes (?) or Saint Judas Thaddeus (?)
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Master E.S.
artworks.description: The image shows a person wearing long flowing robes and a hood, standing upright. They are facing slightly to the left, with hands in front holding a saw. The person has distinct facial features, a contemplative expression, and their hair is mostly covered. The attire features draping folds and layered fabric, with no visible jewelry. In the background, there is a textured surface with artistic accents, including a halo around the head and the name "Juda" in stylized script. The floor has a tiled pattern.

artworks.title: Saint Judas Thaddeus (?) or Saint Simon (?)
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Master E.S.
artworks.description: The image features a person standing and holding a large wooden cross. They have a fabric covering their head and a halo, dressed in a robe. The background is plain with linear designs, and the floor has a tiled pattern.

artworks.title: Saint Matthias (?)
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Master E.S.
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing on a tiled floor. He has long wavy hair, a beard, chiseled facial features, and a contemplative expression. He wears a voluminous robe and holds a large axe. There is a halo above his head with the name "Saucit Xeaximas" inscribed on either side. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Saint Peter
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man standing in an arched alcove. He is holding a large key in his right hand and gripping his cloak with his left hand. The man has a round face, a flowing beard, and shoulder-length hair. He stands upright with a calm expression. He wears a draped robe that reaches his feet, creating voluminous folds. A circular halo surrounds his head. The alcove is shaded for depth, with a plain background. Inscribed initials are visible below his feet.

artworks.title: Saints Thomas and James the Less
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem
artworks.description: The image shows two people within an architectural frame. On the left, a person holds a sword, with curly hair and a short beard. On the right, another person looks down at an open book. Both wear robes and halos. The background is detailed with arches and a patterned wall. At the bottom, there is Latin text in a decorative font.
